videos.title: Turn any Website into API for your AI agent with this free tool #APIAnything #ai #coding
videos.description:
API Anything is a free, open-source tool that turns websites into APIs your AI agent can call. A browser agent opens a page and clicks around just like you, which is slow and expensive. API Anything skips the page: every time you search, a site quietly sends its own request for the results, and API Anything copies that request so your agent can resend it with new words. Ideal for web scraping in python and other languages.
